title: streamNotifications request
description: GET /v1/notifications/stream - request. Server-Sent Events stream of firm notifications ('there are changes, fetch again'); resumable with Last-Event-ID.
$comment: Source: DISENO S7 (b) Connection, (c) connections, (d) RegisterConnectionUseCase / DeliverNotificationUseCase / PushChannel, (e) SSE text/event-stream resumable with Last-Event-ID, (g) coalescing T_coal, (h) push down -> polling every T_poll; DESIGN_DOC push row; PRD RF-032; ADR-009/DEC-13. Audience: PUBLIC (served to the UI). Residency: REGIONAL (cell of the firm, resolved by the stateless global edge firmId -> cell, RF-093); the firm comes from the authenticated context, never from the URL; SSE connections are served by S7 tasks of the cell (Connection item with TTL). Idempotency: safe read (GET); reconnection with Last-Event-ID does not duplicate (notification id = eventId). Pagination: n/a (stream; resume with Last-Event-ID).

headers.description: Contract-relevant request headers (platform/transport headers are out of scope). correlation-id is optional from the UI (generated by ms-experience-gateway when missing, DISENO 3.8.5) and mandatory on service-to-service and operator calls (propagation, RF-120).
